compliance_check.evidence: [Synthetic Summary] Technician provided brief greeting and explanation of delay. Minimal formal introduction structure observed. Customer expressed work-from-home constraints.
compliance_check.suggestion: Open with name, company, role, purpose; confirm it’s a good time.

compliance_check.evidence: [Synthetic Summary] Discussion of system efficiency issues, temperature differentials, and aging equipment. Customer acknowledged equipment age and recurring problems. Limited systematic diagnosis approach.
compliance_check.suggestion: Probe symptoms, duration, comfort by room, prior fixes, utility bills, constraints.

compliance_check.evidence: [Synthetic Summary] Comprehensive presentation of four equipment options ranging from like-for-like replacement to heat pump systems. Discussion of California energy regulations and rebate opportunities. Technical details provided but potentially overwhelming for customer.
compliance_check.suggestion: Compare options, costs, rebates, permits/HERS, warranties, trade-offs, savings.

compliance_check.evidence: [Synthetic Summary] Limited upselling observed. Plywood replacement mentioned due to water damage concerns. HERS testing discussed as requirement rather than customer benefit. Missed opportunities for value-added services.
compliance_check.suggestion: Offer only need-based upsells; tie benefits to diagnosed issues.

compliance_check.evidence: [Synthetic Summary] Maintenance program briefly mentioned in context of warranty matching. No standalone presentation of maintenance benefits or pricing provided.
compliance_check.suggestion: Pitch plan explicitly—price, cadence, inclusions; link to warranty terms.

compliance_check.evidence: [Synthetic Summary] Customer-initiated financing discussion. Multiple options presented including 120-month terms at 8.99% and various payment structures. Clear explanation of early payoff options and interest calculations.
compliance_check.suggestion: Present financing options proactively earlier in the sales process to remove price objections.

compliance_check.evidence: [Synthetic Summary] Professional handling of customer's need to consult with spouse. Payment collected for service call. Follow-up process established but limited urgency creation.
compliance_check.suggestion: Recap decisions, email quotes, schedule follow-up with all decision-makers, thank the customer.

All specific customer information has been removed and replaced with representative dialogue patterns common in HVAC service interactions.
